company_pages.heading: Let’s Stand Together — Help a Patient in Ethiopia Get the Care They Deserve
company_pages.description:
Every day across Ethiopia, countless people face serious health challenges — not because treatment isn’t available, but because they simply can’t afford it.

TenaFirst Plus is bridging this gap through an innovative Telemedicine platform that connects patients with doctors for medical consultations — even from the most remote areas. Yet, for many, financial limitations still prevent them from accessing essential healthcare services, medications, or follow-up care.

That’s why TenaFirst Plus is calling on Ethiopians in the diaspora and friends of Ethiopia to join a compassionate mission:

💙 Support a Patient in Ethiopia Who Cannot Afford Care

Even a small contribution can make a life-changing difference:

$10 covers an online medical consultation.

$25 supports a follow-up and essential lab tests.

$50+ funds ongoing treatment for chronic illnesses.

Your contribution goes directly toward helping patients receive timely, life-saving care through our secure digital health system. Together, we can make healthcare accessible for all.

💰 Ways to Contribute

💳 Commercial Bank of Ethiopia (CBE)
Account Name: TenaFirst Plus
Account Number: 1000643563219

🇺🇸 For USA Communities (Zelle / Mobile Transfer)
Account Name: TenaFirst Plus (Ayele Kebede Sorri, USA)
Phone: +1 (703) 677-4571

🙏 Thank You

Your generosity helps restore hope, dignity, and health to those in need.
Together, we can build a stronger and healthier Ethiopia.
